The 2014-15 president photographed in August 2014, when the Herald was still reporting her as Nicki Seay. The Chambers wall carries her twice, as Janet "Nicki" Seay for 2014 and Nicki Taylor for 2014-15; the Herald shows one continuous term and a change of surname, and this archive counts one president.

Jessica Martin, then vice president of administration, ran for SGA president against Nick Todd in the March 2004 election. The photograph is the one printed in the shaded candidate-profile box beside her article, which gives her major as public relations and sociology and lists her campus involvement, beginning with the vice presidency of administration and naming her earlier work as a resident assistant at Northeast Hall. She lost the election and served as chief of staff under Patti Johnson for 2004-05.
